_doc: TAUGHT form->meaning constructions (construction grammar). Each is graph DATA pairing a surface PATTERN (literal tokens + {slots}) with a MEANING template that binds the slots onto a seeded communication concept. A GENERAL matcher applies whichever constructions are present — adding a construction is adding data, not code. The first family is the COPULA / EQUATIVE mapping onto the seeded `relation` concept (the N of Y = X), realized in the existing {event,agent,patient} frame so the normal QA matches it: event=<relation>, agent=<value>, patient=<owner>. This is the language layer the concept seed was the target for.

constructions._doc: QUESTION constructions for a research-math QUESTION BANK (HLE). A question asks for a TARGET OPERATION applied to an OBJECT (and its parameters): the IMPERATIVE 'Compute the <target> of <object>' / 'Compute <target>' research register, plus the interrogative 'What is the <relation> of <owner>' already above. They realize the SAME {event,agent,patient} relation frame the equative family uses (event=the target operation = the {relation}; patient=the object = the {owner}; agent=?WHAT the value asked for) so the comprehension front reads the target+object off the held frame uniformly. A thin target-op lexicon (domains/comprehend_question.py over graph data) then maps the comprehended relation-phrase -> the formal target op + the object -> its parameters. Adding a question SHAPE = adding a construction here, not code; a relation-phrase / object-shape the lexicon does not cover is the comprehension frontier (honest).

DEFINITIONS are NO LONGER parsed by per-surface-form constructions. They are parsed by the agent's HELD genus-differentia STRUCTURE (the `definition` communication-concept in seeds/communication_concepts.json — a linguistic universal carried as graph data: definiendum / genus / differentia / preface + the markers). ONE general genus-extraction (domains/construction_grammar.extract_definition) REALIZES that structure over ANY definitional sentence — strip a leading PREFACE adjunct ('In <field>,', 'roughly speaking,', 'formally,'), find the copula 'is a/an/the', take the HEAD NOUN of the genus noun phrase up to a DIFFERENTIA marker (that/which/used/with/for/of/whose/where/,), return {term, genus, differentia, preface}. read_and_ground's COMPREHEND step calls that extraction (replacing the ~25 per-form definitional constructions that used to live here). A sentence with no extractable genus (no copula / a pronoun-only predicate) returns None — un-comprehended, the honest remaining limit. The EQUATIVE / RELATION constructions above ('what is the N of Y', 'X is the N of Y') stay: they map a QUESTION/assertion onto the `relation` concept's QA frame, a different job from definitional GROUNDING.
